app.title: Sebded Sloth OS
welcome.heading: Ansuf ɣer Sloth OS!
welcome.text: Tzemreḍ ad tɛerḍeḍ anagraw mebla ma tesbeddeḍ-t, neɣ ad t-tesbeddeḍ ɣef uselkim-ik. Asebded yettawi kra n tesdatin, s kra n yesteqsiyen kan.
region.heading: Anasiw d tamnaḍt n wakud
region.try_keyboard_hint: Aru da i usenqed n tmerna
region.note: Tzemreḍ ad ten-tbeddleḍ ticki deg yiɣewwaren n unagraw.
disk.heading: Anida ara t-nesbedd?
disk.text: Fren aḍebsi anida ara yebded Sloth OS.
disk.none: Ur d-nufi ara aḍebsi i usebded.
disk.too_small: Meẓẓi aṭas: ilaq ma drus 40 GB.
disk.removable: Wa d aḍebsi azɣaray (am USB). Tebɣiḍ s tidet ad tesbeddeḍ da?
disk.small: Cwiṭ d imeẓẓi: i wuraren, ilaq ma drus 120 GB.
confirm.heading: Ayen akk yellan deg uḍebsi-a ad yettwakkes
confirm.text: Sloth OS ad yesseqdec aḍebsi akk: {disk}. Ayen akk yellan tura (ifuyla, ihilen, inagrawen nniḍen) ad yettwakkes i lebda.
confirm.windows: Deg uḍebsi-a yella Windows. Seld asebded, Windows d yifuyla-s akk ad ruḥen. Ma tebɣiḍ ad ten-teǧǧeḍ, eg qbel aḥraz n yifuyla-k.
confirm.checkbox: Fehmeɣ belli isefka akk n uḍebsi ad ttwakksen
stage.copy: Anɣal n Sloth OS ɣer uḍebsi…
install.note: Ɣef leḥsab n uselkim-ik, aya yettawi 5–20 n tesdatin. Ur t-sexsay ara.
done.heading: Asebded ifuk!
done.text: Ales asekker n uselkim. Mi ara yeqqim ugdil d aberkan, kkes USB. Deg usekker amenzu ad d-tesnulfuḍ amiḍan-ik, syin ifuk.
error.heading: Asebded ur yeddi ara
error.log_hint: Ma tsutreḍ tallalt, talqayt tella deg /tmp/sloth-install.log.
error.not_authorized: Ur d-nwi ara tasiregt n usebded.
error.bad_disk: Ur yezmir ara ad yebded deg uḍebsi-a. Fren wayeḍ.
error.bad_input: Yiwen seg yiɣewwaren ur yeɣbel ara. Uɣal ɣer deffir, senqed-iten.
error.install_failed: Yella wugur deg unɣal n unagraw ɣer uḍebsi. Isefka yellan deg uḍebsi zemren ad ttwakksen yakan.
error.configure_failed: Anagraw yebded, maca tutlayt d unasiw ur ttwasbedden ara. Ɛreḍ tikkelt nniḍen; ma ur yeddi ara, tzemreḍ ad ten-tesbeddeḍ deg yiɣewwaren n unagraw seld asekker amenzu.
